description: WHICH PRODUCT a barcode (or a brand + model number, or a product name) is, read from the web: Google web + shopping results (shops, barcode databases, makers) read by a language model, a shop page's own barcode confirming it where one does, then the same product on our Amazon and Walmart records. USE WHEN the user has a UPC / EAN that product (gtin) does not resolve, a supplier line with a barcode or model number, or asks what a barcode is. DON'T USE for a barcode our records hold (product with gtin is cheaper), for an ASIN or a Walmart item (already identified: product), or for where else it is sold (web_offers). RETURNS outcome (identified | not_identified), identity (name, brand, model, size, pack, category, confidence high | medium | low, confirmed_by barcode_on_page | search_results | our_records, evidence[] with source, url, title), listings[] (the same product per marketplace: marketplace, product_id, title, brand, price, currency, product_url, match with matched_by and confidence), search, searched_at. HONESTY: not_identified means the web results name no one product with enough confidence, not that it does not exist; a low-confidence guess is shown as such. LATENCY 10-40 SECONDS; if still running the tool says so: call again with the same arguments. COST paid plans. 20 credits identified, 10 when the search ran and the web names no one product; a failed search is free. The same input asked again within 24 hours is answered from that search at the same price.

brand.description: The product's brand (with model or title).

gtin.description: A barcode: UPC-12, EAN-13, GTIN-14 or ISBN-13.

marketplaces.description: Where to find its listings: Amazon marketplaces and walmart, comma-separated.

max_age_hours.description: Answer from an identification of the same input finished within this many hours (same price). 0 = a fresh search.

title.description: The product's name, when there is no barcode.

name: web_identify
